name: peakusage
description: Get more done per context window and usage limit. Efficiency habits, Markdown handoffs, relevant-skill restoration, and opt-in fresh-session rollover in the Claude Code terminal.

autostart.title: Start monitoring automatically
autostart.description: on: monitor every session without /peak-usage start. In the desktop Code tab it asks Claude to hand off; in a terminal it follows the rollover mode. off: wait for /peak-usage start.

mode.title: Rollover mode
mode.description: Automatic rollover or handoff suggestions after opt-in

soft_percent.title: Soft context percentage
soft_percent.description: Review remaining work at the lower of this percentage and the token cap

soft_cap_tokens.title: Soft token cap
soft_cap_tokens.description: Absolute occupied-token checkpoint. Zero disables the cap.

hard_percent.title: Hard context percentage
hard_percent.description: Prioritize a safe checkpoint at this context percentage

skill_mode.title: Skill restoration
skill_mode.description: Which confirmed, relevant skills may carry over

skill_allow.title: Skill allowlist
skill_allow.description: Comma-separated exact skill IDs for allowlist mode

skill_deny.title: Skill denylist
skill_deny.description: Comma-separated exact skill IDs to exclude from restoration
